verdict_reason: Transition-to-event mapping correctly implements the ticket's corrected catalogue and matches its test coverage, but a misplaced field orphans the resolvedForOutbox Javadoc and the submission-event check duplicates logic that also lives in OutboxService.

todos.issue: The DRAFT_GRADE_EVENTS field (+ its line comment) was inserted between the /** ... */ Javadoc block and the resolvedForOutbox method it documents, so the Javadoc now attaches to the field instead of the method — resolvedForOutbox is left with no doc comment, and DRAFT_GRADE_EVENTS carries a description ('The notification as every outbox event should carry it...') that has nothing to do with it.
todos.fix: Move the DRAFT_GRADE_EVENTS constant (with its own // line comment) above the Javadoc block, or below the resolvedForOutbox method, so the Javadoc sits immediately before the declaration it describes with no other declaration in between.

todos.issue: writeWithOutbox now re-derives 'is this a submission event' with an inline eventType == NOTIFICATION_SUBMITTED || eventType == NOTIFICATION_SUBMISSION_AMENDED check to decide whether to mint submittedAt, duplicating OutboxService.SUBMISSION_EVENT_WIRE_VALUES which encodes the same set for versionId — a third event ever added to one set and not the other silently desyncs submittedAt from versionId.
todos.fix: Expose the submission-event set once (e.g. a static predicate/EnumSet on OutboxEventType) and have both writeWithOutbox and OutboxService.computeVersionId consult it, so there is one place that defines which events represent a submission.
